items.title: Google and Meta Open-source TorchTPU to Bring Native PyTorch Support to Google TPUs
items.summaryShort: Google and Meta Open-source TorchTPU to Bring Native PyTorch Support to Google TPUs. TorchTPU is an open-source project developed by Google in collaboration with Meta that provides a native PyTorch backend for Google TPUs.
